$comment: Initial client JavaScript per route, gzipped kB. A ratchet: set just above what the route ships, lowered as it improves. See scripts/first-load.mjs. 2026-09-13: /, /privacy, /welcome, /prediction and /casino raised by 12-32 kB for the Watchtower error reporting SDK (@sentry/nextjs). It is loaded statically on purpose: deferring it would move the bytes out of first load but miss the hydration-time crashes that are the most valuable thing it catches. 2026-09-15: raised across the board for the Privy -> Decane migration. The Decane wallet SDK is resident in the signed-in shell, and Privy stays alongside it until the sweep retires, so the floor under every authenticated route moved. Measured, not guessed: each value is the route's actual size plus 20 kB. Before raising it, ~640 kB was taken back out of the shell by deferring the migration sheet (it mounts the whole Privy SDK) and its adapter list (which reaches into four feature barrels) behind next/dynamic - see components/layout/migration-sheet-host.tsx. These numbers come down again when the sweep is retired and Privy leaves the tree.
